text:
Let me re-read the original problem carefully.

**Given information:**
- Last year, Regina wrote 9 novels
- She also read 15 books that were not her own (irrelevant information)
- The number of novels she wrote last year is ¾ of the number she has written this year

**Setting up the equation:**

Let x = number of novels she wrote this year

9 = ¾ × x

**Solving for x:**

x = 9 ÷ (3/4)
x = 9 × (4/3)
x = 36/3
x = 12

**Final Answer: Regina has written 12 novels this year.**
